newsitem.title: USA: Jet evacuated after engine fire at Chicago airport.
newsitem.headline: Jet evacuated after engine fire at Chicago airport.

text.p: An engine fire on a United Airlines jet taxiing toward takeoff forced the 59 people on board to evacuate down emergency chutes Monday, a Chicago airport spokesman said. No one was hurt.
The Boeing 737 was headed for Philadelphia from O'Hare International Airport, and the 54 passengers and five crew members were bused back to the terminal.
The cause of the fire was being investigated, a spokesman for Chicago's Aviation Department said.
Chicago is the major hub for United Airlines, a unit of UAL Corp..
